# Proxmox VE API coverage

The SDK reaches **248 of 675 endpoints (36.7%)** in the Proxmox VE 9.2 REST API.

The percentage is **not a target**. It is measured against the *entire* REST
API, including surfaces no SDK consumer has asked for; driving it up for its own
sake would mean shipping untested breadth. Read it as a map of what exists, and
use the per-service tables to find whether a specific endpoint is reachable.

| | |
|---|---|
| Measured against | Proxmox VE 9.2 (`apidoc.js from r740a (INV-0004)`, captured 2026-07-19) |
| Denominator | 675 endpoints in `cmd/pve-schemadiff/testdata/baseline.json` |
| Numerator | 248 distinct `mockpve` routes (248 matched a real endpoint) |
| Regenerate | `just coverage` |

A **covered** endpoint has a `mockpve` route, which by this repo's discipline of
testing every op against `mockpve` means an SDK method drives it. A **stub** is a
deliberate `pverr.ErrUnsupported`, with its reason. **Out of scope** is a decision,
with the document that made it. Everything else is a **gap** — including families
nobody has triaged yet.

## Covered outside REST

PVE serves no endpoint for these; the SDK covers them over the `proxmox/ssh`
side channel, so they appear in no table below.

- snippet and backup upload into /var/lib/vz (ssh.UploadSnippet, ssh.UploadBackup)
- arbitrary node commands, including custom scripts (ssh.Exec)
- ZFS RAIDZ expansion, a `zpool attach` (see storage.ExpandRAIDZ)
- Ceph RBD mirroring, an `rbd mirror` CLI feature (see ceph.GetMirrorStatus)
- raw storage-plugin ops, e.g. volume snapshots (see storage.VolumeSnapshots)
